summary: Reviewed the walk-in launch changes with emphasis on retired Sunday-lunch assumptions, alternate booking paths, cache/date behaviour, and customer-visible copy. The main risk is false confidence from fixing the primary booking route while leaving old assumptions in SEO content, repo guidance, and possibly a secondary booking endpoint. The included primary proxy and launch banner logic are directionally sound, but the rollout is not yet complete enough to satisfy the stated concerns.
appears_sound: app/api/table-bookings/route.ts:101 normalises legacy and management payload shapes while excluding inbound sunday_lunch, booking_type, menu_selections, and sunday_preorder_items from the forwarded payload.
app/api/table-bookings/route.ts:286 adds booking_type='regular' at the final upstream body construction, so hostile booking_type cannot survive in the included public proxy route.

components/announcements/LaunchAnnouncementClient.tsx:25 re-checks launch state on mount and every 60 seconds; components/announcements/__tests__/LaunchAnnouncement.test.tsx covers pre-launch, launch-day, post-expiry, and interval switching.
lib/constants.ts:38 centralises the large-group deposit threshold at 10 and lib/__tests__/large-group-deposit.test.ts covers the 9/10/11 boundaries.

findings.description: The /sunday-lunch page still ships post-launch claims unconditionally before launch. On 2026-04-28, metadata and FAQ copy say walk-ins/no pre-order are available even though the launch starts on 2026-05-17.
findings.evidence: app/sunday-lunch/page.tsx:26 says 'Walk-in friendly Sunday roast served 1pm-6pm', and the FAQ later says walk-ins are welcome with no pre-order while only SundayLunchHowItWorks is date-aware.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: If this branch will not be published until after 2026-05-17, the pre-launch falsehood disappears.
findings.what_would_confirm: Confirm the deploy date; if deploying before 2026-05-17, all visible /sunday-lunch post-launch claims need the same date-aware treatment.

findings.description: The customer-visible content sweep is incomplete: active blog pages still describe Sunday lunch as requiring pre-order, Saturday cutoff, or a Sunday-specific deposit. This directly contradicts the retired cutoff/preorder/deposit policy.
findings.evidence: content/blog/60th-birthday-party-ideas-venues/index.md:40 says Sunday lunch requires advance booking, £10 per person deposit, and Saturday 1pm pre-order; similar stale claims appear in family-friendly-sunday-lunch-heathrow, vegetarian-pub-food-near-heathrow, and best-sunday-roast-surrey.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: Some posts could be intentionally archival, but these pages contain current booking CTAs and operational guidance.

findings.description: The sanitizer is demonstrated for /api/table-bookings, but the pack still references a live /api/table-bookings/create route and the shared API client retains retired sunday_lunch/menu-selection plumbing. A stale or hostile client could bypass the new strip/regularisation if that route does not independently sanitize.
findings.evidence: tests/api/table-bookings.test.ts:7 imports POST from app/api/table-bookings/create/route, while lib/api/client.ts:44 still defines sunday_lunch?: boolean and includes Sunday pre-order summary helpers.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: The hidden create route may already force regular bookings or be unreachable from production UI.
findings.what_would_confirm: Review app/api/table-bookings/create/route.ts and grep public callers or traffic logs for use of /api/table-bookings/create.

findings.description: public/llms.txt contradicts the operational source of truth for opening and kitchen hours. Because this file is intended for LLM/AI retrieval, it can propagate wrong hours even after the launch copy is corrected elsewhere.
findings.evidence: public/llms.txt:23 says Sunday opening is 12pm-9pm and public/llms.txt:28 says Saturday kitchen is 12pm-9pm, while docs/copy-assumptions.md:22-23 says Saturday kitchen 1pm-7pm and Sunday 1pm-6pm.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: If llms.txt intentionally targets a different future hours schedule, docs/copy-assumptions.md should be updated first.

findings.description: Project guidance still states the old Sunday-lunch rule, contradicting the new docs and implementation. Future agents following repo instructions could reintroduce advance-booking/prepayment assumptions.
findings.evidence: CLAUDE.md:68 says Sunday lunch requires advance booking and prepayment, while docs/copy-assumptions.md:28-34 says no pre-order and no Sunday-specific deposit after the walk-in launch.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: The CLAUDE.md excerpt may be static reviewer context rather than a file updated in this branch.
findings.what_would_confirm: Decide whether project CLAUDE.md must be revised or whether docs/copy-assumptions.md explicitly supersedes that critical-business-rule line.

findings.description: The per-page revalidate rollout appears incomplete for pages that now render LaunchAnnouncement. Client-side recompute mitigates interactive users, but stale server HTML can persist for crawlers, no-JS clients, or pre-hydration views if those routes keep longer ISR defaults.
findings.evidence: app/easter/page.tsx:6, app/fathers-day/page.tsx:6, and app/mothers-day/page.tsx:7 import LaunchAnnouncement, while their visible page snippets do not show the revalidate=3600 export used in app/page.tsx:44 and app/sunday-lunch/page.tsx:21.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: A hidden lower export in the truncated files or a route-segment config could set revalidate outside the visible snippet.
findings.what_would_confirm: Check the full files or Next build route manifest for revalidate settings on every page that renders LaunchAnnouncement.

empty_categories: No evidence that the included /api/table-bookings route still enforces the retired Saturday 1pm cutoff.
No evidence that the included AI agent route still auto-derives sunday_lunch from a Sunday date.
No defect found in the included LaunchAnnouncement three-state client logic itself; the remaining concern is rollout/caching coverage.
No PII or analytics-data regression was identified in the changed GTM redaction helpers from the provided pack.
